test_title: PYST 13: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: What is the average of 5 consecutive even numbers starting from 20?
solution:
The numbers are:

 
• 20,22,24,26,28
 
• 20 + 22 + 24 + 26 + 28 = 120
 
• 120 ÷ 5 = 24

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
